entries.title: A new model from your own model list names its own provider
entries.body: When a provider in your own model list gains a model, Activity now names that provider, such as "home-lab added coder-2", instead of a subscription like Grok. A provider your list gains for the first time is not announced, the same as a newly connected subscription.

picture.alt: Activity: Grok added grok-4.7 to medium, then home-lab added coder-2.
